title: Paul and Silas in Prison at Philippi
description: Paul and Silas were thrown into prison in Philippi after driving a spirit of divination out of a slave girl. At midnight they sang hymns, an earthquake opened the doors, and the jailer came to faith and was baptized along with his whole household. The next day Paul demanded redress as a Roman citizen.
